findings: ADVISORY (fail-closed gap): workflow_policy() in scripts/verify_main_integration.py builds the .github/workflows inventory from Path.stem, so a duplicate-stem twin (e.g. interpret.yaml beside interpret.yml) passes inventory while never being content-checked, and GitHub Actions executes .yaml workflows; check.yml content (permissions/steps) is likewise never inspected by the policy. Mitigated today by the candidate-tree==reviewed-pilot-tree binding and by check_pilot_publication refusing any .github/workflows path outside ALLOWED_FILES. Recommend comparing full filenames and asserting check.yml keeps contents: read.

VERIFIED (quarantine): all six model workflows exact-match the CONDITION string (workflow_dispatch + pilot ref + pilot destination input + PILOT_REMOTE_RESEARCH_ENABLED), end in a regex-constrained echo/exit-1 guard that is executed and must refuse, allow only three SHA-pinned actions, exactly one fixed boundary-verify run step, and one checkout with persist-credentials: false; no secrets./git push/git pull text; results-validate.yml is hard-disabled (if: ${{ false }}, contents: read).

VERIFIED (identity bindings): verify_main_integration requires 40-hex pins, a clean isolated 'main' checkout owned by the candidate, exact ordered parents [main, pilot], main ancestor-of pilot, and candidate tree byte-identical to the reviewed pilot tree; it re-binds P001 scientific approval (verify_receipt), patient review, and archive review, and performs no merge, push, or dispatch.

VERIFIED (publication authority): workflow_boundary.publish is an append-only compare-and-swap (exact expected-remote pin, ls-remote equality, expected_remote must be ancestor of source, force-with-lease) gated on a full BASE..tip audit that refuses merges, contaminated-history reachability (git errors fail closed), unlisted paths, non-regular modes, >1.5MB/NUL binaries, credential-like bytes, and executed notebook outputs.

VERIFIED (privacy/approvals): 047 cleanup remains rehearsed-only (status REHEARSED_ONLY_REQUIRES_OPERATOR_APPROVAL, remote_operation_executed: false); rehearsal preserves original bytes with bundle+sha256 receipts and python -O-safe checks (if/raise, not assert); residual case-linked metadata in per_case_staging.csv, split_manifest.csv, and staging_audit.json is explicitly disclosed and gated on a separate operator disposition, not silently retained.

MINOR (doc inconsistency): CLEANUP_REVIEW.md's supplemental blob-reachability audit says 'all 11 advertised refs' while CLEANUP_RECONCILIATION_20260906.json lists 12 advertised refs (including refs/pull/1/head); state which inventory the blob audit traversed before any approved push re-audit.

MINOR (test fragility): tests/test_main_integration.py::test_branch_names_are_not_review_pins calls verify('.', ...) and assumes cwd is the repo root; from another cwd the root-identity refusal fires first and the regex assertion fails (fails closed, but brittle). actioner.yml still advertises a propose_improvement input on a fully blocked job — stale, harmless.

SCOPE NOTE: orchestrator.campaign_review.verify_receipt, orchestrator.colab_patient.require_patient_review, orchestrator.archive_preserve.reviewed, and scripts/fetch_provenance.py are invoked but not part of the supplied bundle; approval-preservation guarantees depend on their previously reviewed behavior. Source-only review; no tests or scripts were executed.
